action_figures.name: Action Figures
action_figures.info: 100 figures hidden around Los Santos and Blaine County. Finding all 100 also unlocks an outfit.

playing_cards.name: Playing Cards
playing_cards.info: 54 cards hidden around the map. Collecting all 54 unlocks an outfit. The chips go straight to your Diamond Casino balance.

signal_jammers.name: Signal Jammers
signal_jammers.info: 50 jammers on rooftops and poles — shoot them to destroy. Destroying all 50 unlocks Avi Schwartzman, the best hacker for the Diamond Casino Heist.

peyote.name: Peyote Plants
peyote.info: Eat a peyote plant to turn into an animal for a while (land, sea or bird depending on the plant).

movie_props.name: Movie Props
movie_props.note: 3 more props are inside moving vehicles, so they have no fixed position
movie_props.info: Movie props scattered around the map: 7 at fixed spots, 3 more inside moving vehicles.

media_sticks.name: Media Sticks
media_sticks.note: Some are inside interiors such as the casino or nightclubs
media_sticks.info: USB sticks that unlock new music tracks for the Media Player.

radio_antennas.name: Radio Antennas
radio_antennas.info: Find all 10 antennas to unlock the Still Slipping Los Santos radio station. The cash grows with each antenna found.

ld_organics.name: LD Organics Product
ld_organics.info: LD Organics product hidden around the map; collect all 100 for the bonus.

skydives.name: Junk Energy Skydives
skydives.info: Junk Energy parachute challenges: jump, pass the checkpoints and land on the target. Rewards depend on the medal you earn.

gun_van.name: Gun Van
gun_van.note: Daily: moves every day (1 of 30 spots)
gun_van.info: A van that sells weapons at discount — including items not sold at Ammu-Nation. It parks in a different spot every day.

ls_tags.name: LS Tags
ls_tags.note: Daily: 5 appear each day (from the first set of 30)
ls_tags.info: Graffiti tags that appear around the city each day; spray over them to earn the reward.

hidden_caches.name: Hidden Caches
hidden_caches.info: Underwater crates — use a submarine, Kraken or scuba gear. 10 random spots are active each day.

shipwrecks.name: Shipwrecks
shipwrecks.note: Daily: 1 spot each day along the coast
shipwrecks.info: One wreck on the coast each day, with a chest to collect.

treasure_chests.name: Treasure Chests (Cayo Perico)
treasure_chests.note: Daily: 2 spots each day on Cayo Perico
treasure_chests.info: Cayo Perico only: 2 chests are active each day.

buried_stashes.name: Buried Stashes (Cayo Perico)
buried_stashes.note: Daily: 2 spots each day on Cayo Perico
buried_stashes.info: Cayo Perico only: 2 stashes to dig up each day.

jack_o_lanterns.name: Jack O' Lanterns
jack_o_lanterns.info: Halloween event: find and smash the pumpkins.

snowmen.name: Snowmen
snowmen.info: Christmas event: find and destroy the snowmen.

yuanbao.name: Yuanbao
yuanbao.info: Lunar New Year event: collect the gold ingots.

weed_packages.name: Weed Packages
weed_packages.note: Special event: 10 spots per day while active
weed_packages.info: Special event: 10 packages appear each day while it runs.
